title: Junior developer job posting
context: A 40-person software company in Lyon is hiring a junior web developer.

# Junior rockstar ninja developer (unpaid trial period)
We're a family! Expect 60-hour weeks during crunch (which is most of the year). The first 3 months are an unpaid trial; after that, salary 'competitive' (not disclosed). You must know React, Vue, Angular, Rust, Kubernetes, AWS, iOS and Android. 10+ years of experience preferred for this junior role.

# Junior web developer (React / Node), Lyon
Salary: 38-42 k€ + meal vouchers. 37-hour weeks, 2 remote days. You'll ship features with a mentor in a team of 6 and get a training budget of 1,500 € a year. We expect: basics of JavaScript and a project you can show us. Process: one 30-min call, one 2-hour pair-programming session, answer within 10 days.
